Inside Macintosh: Telephony /
Chapter 5 - Telephone Manager Messages / Telephone Manager Message Reference
Constants

Intercom States

The value parameter of the telCAIntercomMsg message (page 5-23) indicates the outcome of intercom activity. It contains one of the following constants. 
enum {
   telIntercomEst          = 0,
   telIntercomComplete     = 1,
   telIntercomFailed       = 2
};
Constant descriptions
telIntercomEst
A intercom activity has been established.
telIntercomComplete
The intercom activity has completed.
telIntercomFailed
The intercom activity failed.
